name: AdaptlyPost
tagline: One bot that writes, queues and posts to nine social networks

source.excerpt: Shared as a single-bot publishing desk covering nine social platforms.

body:
## What it does

Write the post once and it takes care of everything after that: drafting, holding the piece in a queue, then pushing it live across nine networks - X, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, Threads, Pinterest and Bluesky - on whatever timetable you set for it. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @tarasshyn shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
